name: Ratio
tagline: Finds the line in your post that will get quoted back at you
description: A second opinion before you hit send. Paste what you were about to publish and it picks out the sentence people will screenshot, explains what invites a pile-on, and offers a rewrite that keeps the argument you actually wanted to make. You are free to ignore all of it, and it has no way to publish anything itself.
author: Don
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
